4. Inquest Report/ U.D. Case
5. This is a case of cheating that occurred prior to 25.08.2025 and registered FIR on 25.08.2025 at 08:00hrs in which the complainant R.Venkata Ramana Naik, S/o. Ramulu late, Age/49 years, working as AO, Sports Authorities of Andhra Pradesh. He reported receiving a video of a conversation between two individuals discussing suspicious interactions involving an unknown person and another individual using mobile number (Whatsapp:+91-9440755843), regarding the posting of DSC-2025. The conversation reveals a discussion about teacher jobs under the 3% sports quota, suggesting that these positions are being offered through a backdoor process in exchange for cash. The suspect is allegedly demanding money for the allocation of jobs, falsely claiming that the process is supported by higher authorities. The actions of the individual in the audio have raised doubts among sports quota candidates about the integrity of the government recruitment process, leading to widespread concern and confusion in society. It was also found that this individual had a phone conversation with another person, during which he impersonated a government official and attempted to defraud candidates by demanding money.
